larvacide.translation: [化] 灭蛹剂; 杀幼虫剂

larvae.definition: n the immature free-living form of most invertebrates and amphibians and fish which at hatching from the egg is fundamentally unlike its parent and must metamorphose
larvae.translation:
幼虫(昆虫), 幼体, 蚴(蠕虫)
[医] 幼虫(昆虫), 蚴(蠕虫)

larval.definition:
s. immature of its kind; especially being or characteristic of immature insects in the newly hatched wormlike feeding stage
a. relating to or typical of a larva
larval.translation:
a. 幼虫的, 幼虫状态的
[医] 幼虫的, 蚴的, 隐蔽的, 潜在的

larval intracavitary.translation: [医] 幼虫疗法, 蛆虫疗法

larvas.translation: n. （昆虫的）幼虫, 幼体( larva的名词复数 )

larvated.definition: a. Masked; clothed as with a mask.

larvicide.definition: n. a chemical used to kill larval pests
larvicide.translation:
n. 杀幼虫剂
[医] 杀幼虫剂

larvicides.definition:
plural of larvicide
n. a chemical used to kill larval pests
larvicides.translation:
(larvicide 的复数) n. 杀幼虫剂
[医] 杀幼虫剂

larviform.definition: a. Having the form or structure of a larva.

larviparous.definition:
a. Depositing living larvae, instead of eggs; -- said of
   certain insects.

lary.definition: n. A guillemot; -- called also lavy.
lary.translation: n. 天琴座；拉里（男子名）

laryng-.translation: 表示“喉的, 喉部的”之义

laryngal.translation:
a. 喉音的
n. 喉音

laryngeal.definition: a. of or relating to or situated in the larynx
laryngeal.translation:
a. 喉头的, 喉头治疗用的
n. 喉部, 喉音

laryngeal chorea.translation: [医] 喉头舞蹈病, 膈痉挛

laryngeal diphtheria.translation: [医] 喉白喉, 膜性喉炎

laryngeal epilepsy.translation: [医] 喉性癫痫, 阵咳性昏厥

laryngeal vertigo.translation: [医] 喉性眩晕, 剧咳后晕厥

laryngectomee.translation: n. 接受过喉头切除术的人

larynges.definition: n a cartilaginous structure at the top of the trachea; contains elastic vocal cords that are the source of the vocal tone in speech

laryngismus.definition: n laryngeal spasm caused by the sudden contraction of laryngeal muscles

laryngismus paralyticus.translation: [医] 麻痹性喉痉挛, 喘鸣症(马)

laryngitis.definition: n. inflammation of the mucous membrane of the larynx; characterized by hoarseness or loss of voice and coughing

laryngo-.translation: 表示“喉的, 喉部的”之义

laryngological.definition: a. Of or pertaining to laryngology.
laryngological.translation:
a. 喉科学
[医] 喉科学的

laryngologist.definition: n. One who applies himself to laryngology.
laryngologist.translation:
n. 喉科学家
[医] 喉科学家

laryngology.definition:
n. Systematized knowledge of the action and functions of
   the larynx; in pathology, the department which treats of the diseases
   of the larynx.
laryngology.translation:
n. 喉科学
[医] 喉科学

laryngopharyngeal.definition: a of or relating to the larynx and pharynx

laryngopharyngeal recess.translation: [医] 喉咽隐窝, 喉部(咽)

laryngopharynx.definition: n the lower part of the pharynx

laryngophony.definition:
n. The sound of the voice as heard through a stethoscope
   when the latter is placed upon the larynx.

laryngoscope.definition: n. a medical instrument for examining the larynx

laryngoscopic.definition: a. Of or pertaining to the inspection of the larynx.
laryngoscopic.translation: a. 喉镜的, 喉镜检查的

laryngoscopy.definition:
n. The art of using the laryngoscope; investigations
   made with the laryngoscope.

laryngospasm.definition: n a closure of the larynx that blocks the passage of air to the lungs

laryngostasis.translation: [医] 喉阻塞, 格鲁布, 哮吼

laryngostenosis.definition: n abnormal narrowing of the larynx

laryngotome.definition: n. An instrument for performing laryngotomy.

laryngotomy.definition:
n. The operation of cutting into the larynx, from the
   outside of the neck, for assisting respiration when obstructed, or for
   removing foreign bodies.
laryngotomy.translation:
n. 喉开刀术
[医] 喉切开术

laryngotracheal.definition:
a. Pertaining to both larynx and trachea; as, the
   laryngotracheal cartilage in the frog.

laryngotracheitis.translation: n. [医] 喉气管炎, 家禽呼吸气管病

laryngotracheobronchitis.definition: n inflammation of the larynx and trachea and bronchial passageways

laryngotracheobronchoscopy.translation: [医] 喉气管支气管镜检查

laryngotracheoscopy.translation: [医] 喉气管镜检查, 经口气管镜检查

laryngotracheotomy.definition:
n. The operation of cutting into the larynx and
   the upper part of the trachea, -- a frequent operation for obstruction
   to breathing.

larynx.definition: n. a cartilaginous structure at the top of the trachea; contains elastic vocal cords that are the source of the vocal tone in speech

larynxes.definition: n. a cartilaginous structure at the top of the trachea; contains elastic vocal cords that are the source of the vocal tone in speech
larynxes.translation: n. 喉( larynx的复数形式 )
